text: For the leader. On stringed instruments. A maskil of David,
when the Ziphites came and said to Saul, "David is hiding among us." [AA]
I O God, by your name [1] save me.By your strength defend my cause.
O God, hear my prayer.Listen to the words of my mouth.
Strangers have risen against me;the ruthless seek my life;they do not keep God before them. [AB]Selah
II God is present as my helper; [AC]the Lord sustains my life.
Turn back the evil upon my foes;in your faithfulness, destroy them. [AD]
Then I will offer you generous sacrificeand give thanks to your name, Lord, for it is good.
Because it has rescued me from every trouble,and my eyes look down on my foes. [AE]
